title: The Doctor Who Sold 5,000 Kidneys to the Highest Bidder
hook: A respected transplant surgeon was caught running a black market organ ring from inside a major hospital — 5,000 kidneys, 12 countries, and zero remorse.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines the visceral horror of organ harvesting with a trusted figure (doctor) as the villain — intense moral outrage drives shares.

title: The Hospital That Sterilized 1,000 Women During C-Sections
hook: For two decades, a hospital secretly tied women's fallopian tubes during cesareans — without asking. They called it 'routine cleaning.'
why_this_can_go_viral: Medical betrayal of reproductive autonomy triggers immediate anger and disbelief — perfect for outrage-driven virality.

title: The Suppressed Cure: $5 Turmeric Stop 90% of Hospital Infections
hook: A simple turmeric extract killed antibiotic-resistant superbugs in clinical trials — then the pharma company bought the patent and vanished it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'natural cure killed by big pharma' narrative is a proven viral magnet — especially when backed by real study data.

title: The Pharmaceutical Giant That Sold a Cold Medicine Causing Heart Attacks
hook: A popular decongestant was linked to 50,000 heart attacks before the manufacturer quietly added a warning — and kept selling it without a recall.
why_this_can_go_viral: Everyone uses cold medicine — personal risk combined with corporate greed creates a high-share emotional reaction.

title: The Experiment That Gave 200 Elderly Patients Fake Heart Surgery
hook: Doctors performed sham heart procedures on 200 seniors — cutting them open, sewing them back up, and doing nothing inside. All to test the placebo effect.
why_this_can_go_viral: The sheer horror of being cut open for nothing is nightmare fuel — the 'placebo surgery' angle is uniquely disturbing and shareable.

title: The FDA-Approved Sleep Aid That Made People Sleepwalk to Their Deaths
hook: A prescription sleeping pill caused users to cook, drive, and even walk off balconies in their sleep — the FDA approved it despite knowing the risks.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'sleepwalking to death' angle is terrifyingly specific and cinematic — viewers will immediately check their own medicine cabinets.

title: The Hospital That Charged Patients for Amputations They Didn't Need
hook: A hospital chain performed 500 unnecessary leg amputations to claim insurance payouts — then sold the removed limbs to research companies.
why_this_can_go_viral: The combination of greed, permanent harm, and body part trafficking is extreme — guaranteed to trigger disbelief and shares.

title: The Doctor Who Sold 10,000 Placebo Pills as 'Cancer Cure'
hook: A licensed oncologist gave sugar pills to 10,000 cancer patients — telling them it was a breakthrough treatment. 4,000 died within a year.
why_this_can_go_viral: Cancer is the ultimate fear — the betrayal by a trusted doctor selling hope as sugar pills is pure viral fuel.

title: The Pharmaceutical CEO Who Priced HIV Drug at $750,000 per Year
hook: A CEO raised the price of a 50-year-old HIV drug by 5,000% overnight — then bragged about it at a shareholder party while patients died waiting.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'evil CEO' narrative is a proven viral archetype — especially when lives are literally on the line.

title: The Experiment That Gave 100 Orphans Paralytic Polio on Purpose
hook: A researcher injected 100 healthy orphans with live polio virus to 'study transmission' — 30 became permanently paralyzed. He won an award.
why_this_can_go_viral: Vulnerable children deliberately infected is the ultimate moral violation — the 'award' detail adds infuriating irony.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How Gym Wipes Caused 30% of Skin Allergies
hook: Antibacterial gym wipes contained a preservative that triggered permanent skin allergies in 1 in 3 users — the EPA approved it despite known risks.
why_this_can_go_viral: Gym-goers are a huge demographic — the product they use daily causing permanent damage is a high-engagement angle.

title: The Doctor Who Faked 5,000 X-Rays to Sell Unnecessary Surgeries
hook: A surgeon altered X-rays to show fractures that didn't exist — then operated on 5,000 healthy patients. He made $50 million before anyone noticed.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that a doctor can fake images and cut people open for profit is a nightmare scenario — pure viral horror.

title: The Pharmaceutical Giant That Hid a Cancer Link in Their Diabetes Drug for 10 Years
hook: A blockbuster diabetes medication doubled bladder cancer risk — the company hid the data for a decade while 100,000 patients took it blindly.
why_this_can_go_viral: Diabetes affects hundreds of millions — a hidden cancer link in a common drug is a massive, personal threat that drives viral sharing.

title: The Experiment That Gave 50 Prisoners Untreated Rabies — Watched Them Die
hook: A researcher infected 50 prisoners with rabies and refused treatment, documenting their neurological decline. Every single subject died a horrific death.
why_this_can_go_viral: Rabies death is one of the most terrifying ways to die — the deliberate refusal to treat is pure evil, guaranteed to generate massive outrage shares.
